svg.title: Astroicers — Offensive Security · Infrastructure · Open Source
svg.desc: Security engineer, out of red teaming and penetration testing. What I have been doing these last few years is writing the attacker's way of thinking into open source: an autonomous red-team platform where the AI picks its own targets and techniques, a protocol that compiles a development playbook into guardrails for AI, and the automation behind Taiwan's security content. You cannot defend what you do not understand attacking — and tools are how that understanding gets handed to the next person.
